_comment: Drug knowledge base seed. General medical truth, patient-independent. The agent RETRIEVES from this; it never generates a medical fact. schedule drives the deterministic legal axis; severity fields feed the clinical axis. Illustrative for the prototype — not a clinical source.

drugs.notes: Take on an empty stomach; separate from calcium/iron/antacids.
Common analgesic; treated as OTC in this demo.
Not a glucose-lowering agent. Not a substitute for prescribed diabetes treatment. Contains ~36% alcohol.

interactions.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition raises statin blood levels

interactions.effect: Reduced thyroid medication effectiveness; separate doses by ~4 hours

class_duplications.note: Two statins together is therapeutic duplication; only one should be used.

contraindications.note: Caution: renal risk in older diabetics; monitor use.

substitution_traps.reason: Presented as a diabetes remedy but does not lower glucose and is not a substitute for prescribed treatment.
substitution_traps.redirect: The patient's prescribed diabetes medicine is Metformin (Glycomet) — offer a refill instead.

schedules.OTC: No prescription or per-order pharmacist gate.
schedules.AYUSH_OTC: AYUSH/OTC product; no prescription gate, but not a substitute for prescribed treatment.
schedules.H: Prescription required; dispensing by/under a registered pharmacist.
schedules.H1: As H, plus stricter sale-register recordkeeping.
schedules.X: As H, plus prescription in duplicate; licensee retains a copy.
